يستذهنوا (form X)
# يَسْتَذْهِنُوا (yastaḏhinū) /jas.tað.hi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# يُسْتَذْهَنُوا (yustaḏhanū) /jus.tað.ha.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
